items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: You heard talk about Mill and Boy. That was the best place for the colored people to go.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Well, I used to go to lawn parties up on Taylor Street. I called the lady, called Miss Cole. Yeah, they used to have plenty of lawn parties going on. Every Sunday, they used to have parties. And what I say, they can't have that today on account of the young generation. Too rough. My days, they have all kind of nice parties. Have somewhere to go on Sunday. Just like the lake. You heard talk about Mill and Boy. That was the best place for the colored people to go. That's all the place we had one…
A lot of colored went out there. We had Mill and Boy.

Yeah, that's where Frederick Cappy used to play music too. And Buddy Petit and them out there. They have a big dance hall there. Yeah. All the colors used to have. That little train used to run. Little Smokey Mary. Used to be on Legion Field. Catch a ride chest sometimes on Legion Field and Canal. I mean on Canal by the river. But most times you had to go to Legion Field and St. Gordon catch it. And go right on by 15 cents. Get you right on the train.
